Tell the [[White Mantle]] about the [[bandit]] raids at [[Miraba]]'s farm.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Tell [[Mantle Knight Karriya]] of [[Miraba]]'s bandit problem. 
* Deliver the [[Token of Janthir]] to Miraba.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Tall Shield]]
** [[Armor rating|Armor]]: 9 (Requires 6 [[Tactics]])
** Armor +5 (while Health is below 50%)
** Armor +5 (while Hexed)

==Walkthrough==
Map travel or walk to [[D'Alessio Seaboard (outpost)|D'Alessio Seaboard]] and talk to [[Mantle Knight Karriya]]. He will give you a [[Token of Janthir]] for Miraba and promise to do something about the bandit problem. Deliver the token to Miraba to get your reward.

This quest (and its prerequisite, [[Duties of a Lionguard]]) can be easily completed with [[Report to the White Mantle]] active, as both require talking to Mantle Knight Karriya.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Miraba
:''"Perhaps you can do a favor for me. Recent days, there've been bandits raiding this area, bold as brass. I don't trust the [[Lionguard]] to deal with this problem. Not when louts like [[Lionguard Riddik|Riddik]] and [[Lionguard Orrin|Orrin]] are the best they have to offer.

:''No, I'd feel safer knowing the White Mantle was aware of the problem. Would you be willing to go to the Mantle '''barracks''' in '''D'Alessio Seaboard''' and talk to White Mantle Knight Karriya? Surely he can do something."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll tell him of your troubles.
| decline = This isn't my concern.
| ask = Listen, if I wanted empty promises, I'd have asked Orrin to help me out. So please, don't waste any more time. The road to '''D'Alessio Seaboard''' is clearly marked, so it shouldn't be too much trouble to find the White Mantle '''barracks'''. Go on now. You did say you'd help me, after all.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Mantle Knight Karriya
:''"I had heard there was some trouble in North Kryta Province, but I am much aggrieved to hear how ineffective the Lionguard is at protecting our people. Here we are, the White Mantle, taking on the greatest of crises facing our land, the walking dead, and the vaunted Lionguard cannot deal with a few brigands!

:''I will send a few men to inquire into the matter, and in the meantime, give this Token of Janthir to the peasant you mentioned. While she bears it, the [[Unseen Ones]] will pay her special attention."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Miraba
:''"What's this? A Token of Janthir? I think I was hoping for a little more "knight" and a little less "Mantle" out of Karriya. Oh well, I guess there's naught to be done but hope this thing works."''
